sections.title: Snapshot
sections.content: Snapshot time: 2026-11-11 17:37 UTC. Scope: Daily. Date range: 2026-11-11 through 2026-11-11. Ranking basis: Daily GitHub Trending star gains observed on the live page.

sections.title: Headline
sections.content: A customizable design system leads the day, while an unusually practical cluster of agent skills, browser automation, and Home Assistant integration also draws strong interest. Personal finance is another standout, led by Sure's +1,079 stars.

sections.title: meta/astryx
sections.description: An open-source React design system built for customization and use by people and coding agents.
sections.why_notable: The strongest daily star-gain signal in the live snapshot; its README describes 150+ components, theming, a CLI, and agent-aware docs/tooling.
sections.unique_caveat: The README labels the project as currently in beta and specifies React 19 or later.

sections.title: we-promise/sure
sections.why_notable: The second-largest daily gain highlights demand for open personal-finance software beyond AI developer tooling.
sections.unique_caveat: The README identifies it as a community fork of the now-abandoned Maybe Finance project and states it is AGPLv3-licensed.

sections.title: addyosmani/agent-skills
sections.description: Production-grade engineering workflows packaged as skills for AI coding agents.
sections.why_notable: Its strong gain reinforces interest in repeatable agent workflows spanning specification, planning, building, testing, review, and shipping.
sections.unique_caveat: README describes agent-specific integrations; the installation path differs by coding-agent environment.

sections.title: vercel-labs/agent-browser
sections.description: A Rust CLI for browser automation by AI agents.
sections.why_notable: A high daily gain for an agent execution tool; its README documents compact page snapshots, element references, and a persistent browser daemon.
sections.unique_caveat: The CLI's element references are tied to the current page snapshot and must be refreshed after navigation or DOM changes.

sections.title: homeassistant-ai/ha-mcp
sections.description: An MCP server for configuring and automating Home Assistant with AI assistants.
sections.why_notable: It connects the agent/MCP trend to smart-home automation; its README documents an in-process Home Assistant integration and multiple client connection paths.
sections.unique_caveat: The documented integration requires Home Assistant 2026.8.0 or newer; some setup guidance differs by Home Assistant version.

sections.title: ZhuLinsen/daily_stock_analysis
sections.description: An LLM-powered multi-market stock-analysis system with market data, news, dashboards, and automated notifications.
sections.why_notable: It applies LLMs to an end-user financial research workflow rather than coding assistance.

sections.title: shadcn/improve
sections.description: Uses a capable model to audit a codebase and create plans for cheaper models to execute.
sections.why_notable: It spotlights a cost-aware model-handoff pattern for code review and execution.
sections.unique_caveat: The API metadata reports no primary language; the latest pushed_at was 2026-09-12 despite a recent repository metadata update.

sections.title: GoogleChrome/modern-web-guidance-src
sections.why_notable: A web-platform entry in the daily trending set, although repository metadata supplied no description.
sections.unique_caveat: GitHub repository metadata contains no description; the report does not infer the repository's purpose from its name.

sections.title: TheAlgorithms/Java
sections.description: A collection of algorithms implemented in Java.
sections.why_notable: It provides a useful non-agent educational counterpoint to the day's AI-heavy tooling.

sections.title: openai/codex-security
sections.description: A CLI and TypeScript SDK for finding, validating, and fixing security vulnerabilities.
sections.why_notable: It represents security-oriented coding-agent tooling, though its daily gain is modest relative to the leaders.

sections.title: Trending Technologies and Themes
sections.content: Agent workflows and coding tools: addyosmani/agent-skills, shadcn/improve, vercel-labs/agent-browser, and meta/astryx. AI applied to existing workflows: homeassistant-ai/ha-mcp and ZhuLinsen/daily_stock_analysis. Open consumer software: we-promise/sure. Web platform guidance and application security: GoogleChrome/modern-web-guidance-src and openai/codex-security. Programming education: TheAlgorithms/Java. Languages across the 10 repos: TypeScript 3; Python 2; JavaScript, Rust, Ruby, and Java 1 each; language unavailable for shadcn/improve.

sections.title: Takeaway
sections.content: Today's strongest signal is practical agent infrastructure: reusable engineering workflows, browser control, and integrations that let assistants act in existing products. But the gains are not exclusively about agents—Sure's personal-finance app and the stock-analysis project show substantial interest in complete user-facing applications too. Treat the ranking and daily gains as a point-in-time GitHub Trending snapshot, not a measure of long-term adoption.

sections.title: Sources and Method
sections.content: Primary source: GitHub Trending repositories, daily, captured at approximately 2026-11-11 17:36 UTC. Corroboration: GitHub REST Search API exact repository matches and REST repository/commit endpoints for metadata and current default-branch SHAs. README details were checked for five narrated entries. Star gains and repo set are from the matching live daily Trending view; totals and SHAs came from REST API moments later and may differ by a few stars. No prior-window comparison was used.
